run_unary_async_benchmark: run a unary async gRPC benchmark client that sends concurrent requests and records query times
run_streaming_async_benchmark: run a bidirectional streaming async gRPC benchmark client with concurrent streaming calls
run_server_streaming_benchmark: run a server streaming async gRPC benchmark client that reads responses from a stream
create_benchmark_channel: create a secure or insecure async gRPC channel with configurable channel arguments and credentials
record_query_time_histogram: record query latency in nanoseconds to a histogram for benchmark performance analysis
